◇◆ STORY ◆◇

厳格に生徒たちを叱っていた女性教師のところに、初めて卒業した生徒が訪れます。しかし、その生徒は酒に薬を混ぜて教師に不快な行為をします。その場面はCCTVに記録され、その生徒から本格的な脅迫を受けることになります。 The main character, a strict female teacher known for hitting her students, is visited by a student who has graduated for the first time. However, the student drugs his drink and behaves badly towards her. The scene is recorded on CCTV, and she starts receiving serious threats from the student.
